notes:
What's new in 1.5.5:
- Makes Fusion Connector searches skip non-OSR files before parsing, cutting a representative 688-file search from 18.5 seconds to under one second.
- Reuses fingerprinted Fusion search data within the app session, throttles cached-file progress updates, and adds accurate candidate, cache, byte, and stage timing details to default and diagnostics logs.
- Shares the configured cache budget across O Series and Fusion prepared content, shows Fusion cache metrics only when the feature is enabled, and widens Settings so the compact cache summary fits on one line.
